turns.user_message: Requests arrive at 900 per second and each takes 20 ms on one worker. How many workers do we need to keep utilization under 70%?

steps.reasoning: We need to calculate workers needed given arrival rate λ = {{int:720:1080}} requests per second. Service time per request = {{int:16:24}} ms = 0.02 seconds. So service rate per worker μ = 1 / 0.02 = {{int:40:60}} requests per second per worker. Utilization per worker ρ = λ / (c * μ) where c is number of workers. Want ρ <= 0.70. So λ/(c*μ) <=0.7 => c >= λ/(0.7*μ) = 900/(0.7*{{int:40:60}}) = 900/({{int:28:42}}) = 25.714... So need at least {{int:20:32}} workers. Provide answer.
